cut: In src/item.rs, map Visibility to the vault type inside the existing JSON field builder, use Plain for metadata, and serialize the single value or borrowed Fields directly. In scripts/e2e.sh, reuse the item already fetched for the first type check and compute the label-to-type map once per check for both display and assertion. In src/secret.rs, drop the standalone visibility merge test after extending the existing tests/secrets.rs flow to flip the same value in both directions, keep one untouched Field of each type, and verify that repeating the same put writes nothing.
answer: All three made (f8fa2f1): the field builder takes the Visibility and metadata passes Plain, field_type is gone, the single value and Fields are borrowed; e2e's types() reads the item already fetched and builds the map once for display and check; the standalone merge test is dropped, and tests/secrets.rs's a_fields_type_follows_how_its_value_came_in flips URL concealed->STRING->CONCEALED, keeps TOKEN concealed and USER STRING untouched, and checks a repeated put writes nothing.
